goals.title: Step 1: Pass market_type on get_market_movement prefetch
goals.description: In src/swarm/engine/seatToolLoop.ts buildPrefetchCalls, always pass market_type for get_market_movement (all|spread|total|ml mapped from spreads/totals/moneyline/h2h, default 'all').
goals.verificationCriteria: A 6-game Market prefetch sends market_type on every call and never returns invalid_market_type.

goals.title: Step 2: Skip unkeyed prop splits and cover all games with primary tool first
goals.description: Do not prefetch get_player_prop_splits unless real player_id and stat_category are known from slate prop rows. Quant prefetches get_matchup_fundamentals for all slate games first, then get_injury_and_roster_delta with remaining maxToolCalls. Market prefetches get_market_movement for all games first, then injury with leftover calls.
goals.verificationCriteria: 6-game game-line Quant prefetch has 0 prop-split calls, 6 fundamentals, and no invented player_id.

goals.title: Step 3: Share short per-game injury evidence with Quant and Market
goals.description: In analystExecution.ts / shared pre-seat prefetch (using GameQueryCache), share a short Injury evidence block on betting-seat prompts within existing maxPromptChars/maxToolResultChars caps without raw board.
goals.verificationCriteria: Quant/Market prompt contains short injury summary (e.g. Lamar Jackson OUT) without raw board.

goals.title: Step 4: Strip approximate odds, percents, and payouts from analysis text
goals.description: In responseGuards.ts guardAnalystResponse and guardManagerResponse, strip ~65%, ~+650, ~=, 'about +650' from insights/summary/analysis/verdict without replacing with defaults or altering toolEvidence/slate prices.
goals.verificationCriteria: ~65% and ~+650 stripped from guarded Quant/manager text while real prices in toolEvidence remain.

goals.title: Step 5: Tests, verification, push branch, and open PR
goals.description: Add tests (A-D) under src/__repro__/ or seat/guard tests, verify with tsc/vitest/smoke-start, push fix/prefetch-args-evidence, and open PR.
goals.verificationCriteria: All new/touched tests pass; tsc & smoke pass; PR opened on GitHub.
